title: Alex Silver pitches BWX Technologies at Sohn 2026
description: Alex Silver, Co-Founder and Chief Investment Officer, Ananym Capital, outlines the investment case for BWX Technologies (BWX), a $20 billion market cap company at Sohn Investment Conference 2026.
summary: The pitch argues that BWX Technologies offers over 100% upside from current levels driven by multiple value creation paths. This potential includes significant upside from developing the mPower reactor and probability-adjusted wins from known, yet unawarded, projects. The thesis is supported by a protected downside provided by the company's contracted, sole-sourced government business.

numbers.quote: BWX is a $20 million market cap that is best known for making the reactors that power the US Navy submarines and aircraft carriers.
The larger of the segments, government operations, accounts for about 75% of the company's revenue.
They have been in an incredible track record having built over 400 nuclear cores for the Navy over time without a single safety incident.

numbers.what: percentage of workforce with government security clearances

numbers.quote: Think about a gigawatt or so in power.
Those power Those provide enough power for a city of 800,000 to a million people.
Those are about 300 MW at most or less, and on the larger end can power a large data center.

numbers.what: timeline for large gas turbine fired plants
numbers.quote: So, we believe the bogey is to deliver a power on time frame competitive with large gas turbine fired plants, which now take about 4 to 5 years based on the backlog of parts.

numbers.what: estimated delivery period for GE Hitachi's BWRX-300
numbers.quote: In fact, it's one of the SMRs that BWX is working on, and they have an estimated delivery period of 4 to 5 years.
The company itself and its investor materials believes the SMR space will be 300 billion by 2040 alone.

numbers.what: upside from pick and shovel wins
numbers.quote: Layering on the probability adjusted of pick and shovel wins for known projects that are not yet awarded is another 50 bucks or 25%.
